criteria.review: REVIEW(golf): 175° ± 10° = straight or nearly straight (165–185°); synthetic ideal face-on 179° (PM3); catalog bent_lead_arm trains at least 175 − 10 (one-sided, review W2)
REVIEW(golf): 2D image shoulder-turn proxy; synthetic 90° turn measures 88 face-on / 76 DTL (PM3); catalog short_shoulder_turn trains at least 85 − 15 (one-sided, review W2)
REVIEW(golf): head may drift a little away from the target while turning (synthetic ideal −18 % torso face-on, PM3/PM4); beyond ≈ −22 % = sway
REVIEW(golf): shaft on the neutral line ± 5°, same as catalog shaft_steep/flat_downswing9; live without club detection only a rough hand estimate
REVIEW(golf): shaft on the neutral line ± 7°, same as catalog shaft_flat/steep_backswing9
REVIEW(golf): hips do not move towards the ball (early extension), catalog early_extension 0 ± 6 % torso
REVIEW(golf): forward bend kept within ± 6° of address
REVIEW(golf): hips clearly over the lead foot in the finish (~20 % torso towards the target) – guess, no source value
REVIEW(golf): head within ± 3 % torso (≈ 1.5 cm) of address at impact, same as catalog putt_head_movement
REVIEW(golf): body sway during the stroke, catalog putt_body_movement 0 ± 4 – series only
REVIEW(golf): forward bend ~30–40° for irons (synthetic iron 38°, driver 32°, PM3); catalog setup_upright/crouched uses 30 ± 5
